meta.name: info-funnel
meta.description: 3-6 阶递减漏斗, 突出转化率 / 筛选比例 / 流量损耗。竖图适合 IG Story / 小红书

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作转化漏斗图，突出流量损耗与筛选比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在社交媒体上展示营销漏斗数据
copy.tagline_en: Create conversion funnel charts highlighting traffic loss and filter ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present marketing funnel data on social media

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你提供的3-6个阶段数据，生成竖屏（9:16）的漏斗信息图HTML文件，展示每阶段数字、转化率及底部流失洞察。
howto.when: 当你要求制作漏斗图，并给出阶段名称和对应数值（如人数、件数）时触发。

say.text: 用日落琥珀色做3步招聘漏斗：投递5000，面试800，录用120。

howto.what_en: Generates a vertical (9:16) funnel infographic HTML based on 3-6 stages of numerical data, showing stage counts, conversion rates, and bottom insight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a funnel chart and provide stage names and corresponding values (e.g., visitors, registrations).

say_en.text: Create a 5-step SaaS funnel: 100k visitors, 18.5k signups, 6.2k trials, 1.45k paid, 920 retained.
say_en.note: Generates funnel with default Klein Blue theme.

say_en.text: Make a 3-step hiring funnel in sunset-amber: 5000 applicants, 800 interviews, 120 hires.
